#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    int size = 2 * n + 1;
    vector<vector<vector<long long>>> dp(size, vector<vector<long long>>(size, vector<long long>(2, 0)));
    dp[0][0][0] = 1;
    for (int depth = 1; depth <= 2 * n; depth++) {
        for (int opened = depth & 1; opened <= depth; opened += 2) {
            if (opened - 1 >= 0) {
                dp[depth][opened][0] += dp[depth - 1][opened - 1][1];
                dp[depth][opened][1] += dp[depth - 1][opened - 1][0];
            }
            if (opened + 1 < size) {
                dp[depth][opened][0] += dp[depth - 1][opened + 1][1];
                dp[depth][opened][1] += dp[depth - 1][opened + 1][0];
            }
            dp[depth][opened][0]++;
            dp[depth][opened][0] %= MOD;
            dp[depth][opened][1] %= MOD;
        }
    }
    cout << dp[2 * n][0][1] << endl;
    return 0;
}
